signal_scoring_rubric.content: Signal strength: STRONG = funding round OR new CRO/CFO/VP Sales hire OR >10% headcount growth; MEDIUM = relevant tech-stack change OR new VP/Director (non-revenue); LOW = general hiring or company news. Recommended priority lift: STRONG -> raise one tier; MEDIUM -> raise one tier only if current stage is Discovery+; LOW -> no change.

sales_signal_playbook.content: Buying-Signals Playbook v3: All priority changes and outbound alerts require rep review before commit. #buying-signals posts must name affected accounts and link the SFDC task. Do not raise an account above 'High'. Account owners are notified automatically when a task is created.

slack_channel_directory.content: Workspace channels: #buying-signals (alerts for AE/SDR team, 38 members), #sales-west (regional standup), #deal-desk (pricing approvals), #general. #buying-signals is monitored by SDR leadership.

tools.name: list_target_company_updates
tools.description: Retrieve recent LinkedIn company updates (posts, headcount trends, announcements) for the target accounts.

tools.name: find_executive_profiles
tools.description: Look up LinkedIn executive profile changes (new hires, role changes) at the target accounts.

tools.name: find_company_posts
tools.description: Pull the full text of recent LinkedIn company posts for the target accounts.

tools.name: lookup_account_records
tools.description: Query existing Salesforce account records (stage, ARR potential, current priority, last activity) for cross-referencing.

tools.name: score_buying_signals
tools.description: Apply the signal scoring rubric to detected signals to classify strength and recommend priority lifts.

tools.name: draft_buying_signals_brief
tools.description: Compose a draft buying-signals brief summarizing detected signals, affected entities, scores, and recommended Salesforce/priority/alert actions for the user to review.

tools.name: create_salesforce_task
tools.description: Create a Salesforce task on an account capturing a buying signal; notifies the account owner automatically.

tools.name: update_account_priority
tools.description: Update the priority field on a Salesforce account to reflect detected signal strength.

tools.name: post_to_buying_signals_channel
tools.description: Post a buying-signal alert naming affected accounts to the #buying-signals Slack channel for the SDR/AE team.

tools.name: read_signal_playbook
tools.description: Read the buying-signals playbook describing review requirements and posting conventions.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
